steps.comment: C398 v3.12 seed sweep: the C397 ace-first scenario (10,77 below ISABEL, COMBUSKEN 20 / MAKUHITA 18 / ZIGZAGOON 17 / TAILLOW 18, slot 1). No wait: the suite seed (s0).
